lessons.title: If only…
lessons.tip: Second conditional = situación imaginaria: «If I had more time, I would travel». Fíjate: past simple + would.

exercises.sentence: If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the piano.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence describes an imaginary present situation?
options: If I were rich, I'd buy a boat.
If it rains, we'll stay in.
If you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.answer: If I were rich, I'd buy a boat.

exercises.prompt: Si hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado el examen.
exercises.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

exercises.sentence: If she ___ (know) about the meeting, she would have come.
exercises.hint: Third conditional: past perfect in the if-clause.

exercises.text: Unless we act now, the problem will only get worse
options: Unless we act now, the problem will only get worse
If we act now, the problem will get worse
Until we act, the problem won't get worse
exercises.answer: Unless we act now, the problem will only get worse

exercises.prompt: Translate: «Yo en tu lugar no lo haría.»
exercises.answer: If I were you, I wouldn't do it
alternatives: If I were you, I would not do it
If I was you, I wouldn't do it
I wouldn't do it if I were you

lessons.title: Big ideas
lessons.tip: Los sustantivos abstractos (freedom, growth, awareness) suelen ir sin «the» cuando hablas en general: «Freedom is important».

options: The happiness doesn't depend of money.
Happiness doesn't depend of the money.

exercises.sentence: There is growing ___ of the impact of plastic on the oceans.

exercises.prompt: La tecnología ha cambiado la forma en que nos comunicamos.
exercises.answer: Technology has changed the way we communicate.

exercises.text: Education is the key to reducing inequality
exercises.answer: Education is the key to reducing inequality

exercises.sentence: It is widely ___ that exercise improves mental health.

exercises.prompt: Translate: «La libertad de expresión es un derecho fundamental.»
exercises.answer: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right
alternatives: Freedom of expression is a fundamental right
